items.headline: ‘I'm particularly curious about what lies ahead’
items.source: Port of Rotterdam Authority news & press releases
items.summary: The new director of PortXL, the maritime accelerator, talks about his career and approach. Eleven startups chosen for the 2026 programme will pitch at a Grand Finale on 3 December.

items.headline: APM Terminals Maasvlakte II and Port of Rotterdam Authority take next step in terminal development
items.impact: Extra quay and capacity for deepsea, feeder and barge vessels could ease container handling at Rotterdam in the longer term. Nothing changes immediately, and construction work could affect the site from late 2027, so planners may simply monitor developments.
items.source: Port of Rotterdam Authority news & press releases
items.summary: APM Terminals Maasvlakte II and the port authority are preparing a further build-out of the Maasvlakte II container terminal, with extra land, a longer quay and more capacity. Approval is still pending, and construction is planned between October 2027 and January 2030.

items.headline: Capacity Arrangement Boluda Tugboats - Activate
items.impact: Vessels using Boluda tugs may be placed on a waiting list, which could shift the timing of arrivals and departures. Tide-bound ships could get priority, and ordering tug services early may help scheduling.
items.summary: A capacity arrangement for Boluda tugboats was switched on on 24 November because of heavy traffic. It covers all areas of the port.

items.headline: Navigational information – Botlek bridge Disruption - De-activate
items.summary: A notice from 24 November says the Botlek bridge is operating again after a disruption. The Harbour Coordination Center can be contacted for more information.

items.headline: Rotterdam plans 711-metre quay extension to add 1.4 million TEU at APM Terminals Maasvlakte II
APM Terminals plans 1.4m teu expansion at Rotterdam’s Maasvlakte II
Ongeluk in tunnel en vrachtwagen met pech vóór tunnel zorgen voor file
items.headline_en: Accident and broken-down truck slow A15 traffic near the Noordtunnel
items.impact: Trucks collecting or delivering cargo on the A15 towards Ridderkerk could have faced delays of up to an hour. The item suggests the disruption was temporary, so later effects on pickups may be limited.
items.summary: An accident and a broken-down truck caused congestion near the Noordtunnel on Wednesday afternoon. Traffic on the A15 towards Ridderkerk was briefly delayed by about an hour.

items.headline: Opnieuw hoge vrachtwagen vast voor Drechttunnel: lange file tijdens ochtendspits
items.headline_en: Over-height vehicle stuck before the Drechttunnel causes a long A16 jam
items.impact: Trucks heading for Rotterdam via the A16 could face delays on the approach. Planners may want to allow extra time for pickups and deliveries, though the item gives no information on how long the jam lasts.
items.summary: A vehicle that was too tall got stuck before the Drechttunnel on the A16 towards Rotterdam on Wednesday morning. A long traffic jam built up during the morning rush.

items.headline: Petitie tegen tolchaos op A24 en hoge boetes: 'Je kan niet betalen achter het stuur'
items.headline_en: Petition over confusion about paying the A24 tunnel toll
items.impact: Truck drivers and carriers using the tunnel could receive reminders or fines if toll payment is missed afterwards, which may add admin work and costs. The item does not say how freight is affected specifically.
items.summary: A petition has been started by former government commissioner Arre Zuurmond over confusion about paying the toll for the A24 tunnel between Vlaardingen and Rozenburg. Each month, about a hundred thousand payment reminders and tens of thousands of fines are sent to drivers who did not pay.

items.headline: Ravage na botsing en vrachtwagen met pech: veel files door ongelukken op A13, A16 en A29
items.headline_en: Crash and broken-down truck cause heavy congestion on the A13, A16 and A29
items.impact: Trucks heading to or from Rotterdam via the A13, A16 or A29 could face delays. However, the report dates from the morning of 24 November and does not say how long the disruption lasted, so planners may want to check current traffic.
items.summary: Tuesday morning brought heavy congestion on several roads in the Rijnmond region. A crash involving two cars on the A13 and a broken-down truck on the A16 caused queues, which also backed up traffic onto the A29.
